text: I read the fault code on the inverter, checked the sensor wiring and found a loose cable.
Switch off, lock it, tag it with my card, and use a meter to test that it is completely dead.
I stop the lot, isolate the suspect pallet, and perform root-cause checks with the tech.
I confirm the safety guard interlocks and never reach past the light curtain.
I inspect distribution switchboards, thermal-scan breakers, and record load readings.
I halt the aisle, dismount safely, and diagnose if the pallet or sensor bracket shifted.
We sync on the warehouse management terminal and I train trainee drivers on stack limits.
I review the inbox, extract purchase orders, and verify billing entries.
I bend conduits, wire relay contactors on the training panel, and test circuits.
Saya buat pemeriksaan rutin sebelum hidupkan mesin setiap hari.
I write the temperature and pressure in the log every hour.
I diagnose why a machine produces defects, then fix the setting or call maintenance.
I test the variable frequency drive and check the motor current when it trips.
Saya buat lockout tagout dan pastikan tiada arus sebelum buka kabinet.
Saya boleh baca program PLC dan ubah sedikit logik tangga.
On a product change I swap the tooling, set up the jig and run a test piece.
Saya buat pemeriksaan visual, periksa kecacatan dan ukur dimensi dengan mikrometer.
I calibrate the gauges first and then check a sample from every lot.
